SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.subtitle, p.main_image, p.sub_images, p.detail, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(s.price) FROM t_product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id), 0) AS price, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s2.stock), 0) FROM t_product_sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = p.id) AS stock, p.status, p.sales, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND COALESCE((SELECT MIN(s.price) FROM t_product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id), 0) >= #{minPrice} AND COALESCE((SELECT MIN(s.price) FROM t_product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id), 0) <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY price ASC ORDER BY price DESC ORDER BY sales DESC ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
